propositions: recheck-review refuses all current-revision findings regardless of type, but bugfix-size-attestation findings can be cured by earning a plan-review attestation on the ticket without code changes

when a plan-review attestation is earned after a bugfix-size-attestation finding is posted, the finding becomes stale but cannot be cleared via recheck-review or no-code-change reruns, forcing spurious code edits

recheck-review must accept bugfix-size-attestation blocks after verifying exactly one blocking finding exists, the finding criterion is bugfix-size-attestation, and the ticket's plan-review attestation classifies as accepted
the retrigger path must resolve the ticket id from the commit message trailer via ticket_for_commit_message, not from the finding detail text, to avoid misreading clipped or truncated finding data
recheck-review must refuse blocks containing bugfix-size-attestation alongside other blocking findings, and must refuse attestations with verdict buckets in FLAG_VERDICTS or infra verdicts
